context:
Goal: a failed round is never quietly forgotten, and a fresh full review still works as it does on main.
Problem (rule): the lane's change reads a fresh round-1 pass after a round-1 fail as open, where main reads it as done, and the review record decision cites no ruling of yours for that line.
Based on (ruling): Nov 7, 13:12 CST, you ruled that a failed fix check counts as the next review round, inside the three-round cap; that ruling covers fix checks only.
Departs from: main, which reads that fresh pass as done — b reads it as open.
Meanwhile: the lane's draft stays a draft under the freeze.
home: decision pr-review-record; draft PR #2545 (failed rounds stay failed)

options.gain: A fresh review behaves as on main.
options.how: Only a fix check after a fail keeps the fail; a fresh full review that passes reads done, as on main.
options.label: Keep "a failed round stays failed" for fix checks only (Recommended)
options.lose: A later fresh pass can follow an earlier fail with no re-read of what failed.

options.how: Any review after a fail keeps the record open until the fail is answered.
options.label: Keep it for every review
options.lose: More re-reads, and two test cases are already re-pointed to fit it.

ref: decision pr-review-record; PR #2545; your Nov 7 ruling on failed fix checks
reply: Your answer, 10:50 CST Nov 10 (none of these): "shouldnt they all read done after they are fixed?". Yes. A fixed change reads done once its next review passes, fresh or fix check, inside the three-round cap. Filed on step review-fix-check-round; its lane builds it when the freeze lifts. (Routed by triage 10:55 CST.)
title: After a failed review round, should a fresh full review's pass still count as done?
why: Recommended: a. A fresh full review behaves as on main, and your fix-check ruling still holds.
